decision_criteria: Use `compliant` only if admissible evidence shows either no material weakness remains or an approved mitigation satisfies the policy threshold.
Use `compliant_with_caveats` only if the certification action itself is evidenced as conditioned on completed required disclosure and is otherwise policy-compliant.
Use `suspicious` if the certification theory is plausible from the evidence but the packet still depends on missing support links, unresolved policy predicates, or future documentation fixes.
Use `noncompliant` if the record shows certification is being defended as if no material limitation exists or if policy-required disclosure/approval is absent and not incorporated into the action.
